dedupe_keys.name: nyc wi fi hotspot locations nyc open data

description: A point inventory of publicly accessible Wi-Fi hotspots in New York City, published on NYC Open Data by the Office of Technology and Innovation. It lists 3,319 hotspots, of which the API reports 2,736 as free, 581 as limited free and 2 partner sites. The page names the providers: CityBridge (LinkNYC free kiosks), Spot On Networks at NYCHA properties, Fiberless on Governors Island, AT&T, partner organisations in parks and the cable franchisees Altice and Spectrum. Each row holds the borough, type, provider, site name, location type, latitude and longitude, remarks, SSID, activation date, and building and lot identifiers (BIN, BBL) plus census tract, neighbourhood and council district codes. Coverage: the five boroughs, with earliest activation in January 2016. Format and access: free download as CSV, JSON or GeoJSON or through the Socrata API; the licence is not stated on the page. Caveats: rows were last updated on 26 September 2019 and the update frequency is listed as as needed, so it is a snapshot for planning, not live status. A separate view, Free Brooklyn Wifi, carries the same schema. Useful for connectivity and digital equity analysis and for emergency communication planning in parks and public space; related records are not yet linked.
